item.text: Version parsing previously treated any one word as Amazon Linux 1, which explains why unsupported releases could fall into legacy behavior. I’ve changed it to recognize only the supported release identifiers and legacy `YYYY.MM` forms, and added scanner parsing for newer `Amazon Linux 20xx` system-release lines. Next I’m adding regression coverage for parsing, each lifecycle date, and unsupported releases.

The targeted Go tests are still running without output, likely during initial compilation. The new coverage also checks support status immediately before and after each configured date, including the extended-support helper’s behavior when no separate extended date is defined.
